<EditForm Model="@_formModel">
    <FormControl Label="User Name" InputType="InputType.Text" @bind-Value="@_formModel.UserName" />
    <FormControl Label="Password" InputType="InputType.Password" @bind-Value="@_formModel.Password" />
    <FormControl Label="Date" InputType="InputType.Date" @bind-Value="@_formModel.Date" />
</EditForm>

@code {
    private FormModel _formModel = new FormModel();
    private class FormModel {
        public string UserName { get; set; }
        public string Password { get; set; }
        public DateTime? Date { get; set; }
    }
}
